sentences.text: Under the current UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, a prepayment charge is not permitted for this borrower profile and floating-rate loan.
Schedule II, row 3 states a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding when pre-payment or foreclosure occurs.
That schedule row does not comply with the current rule because it imposes a prepayment charge where the rule prohibits one.
The older RBI pre-payment-charge directions for floating-rate term loans are no longer in force, so they do not govern this agreement as of 2026-11-23.
